# dIKta.me

> Local, fast, intelligent voice-to-text powered by on-device AI for Windows.

## What is dIKta.me?

dIKta.me is a privacy-first AI voice dictation application for Windows 10+. It runs speech recognition (Whisper V3 Turbo) and language models (Gemma 3, Llama 3) entirely on the user's local GPU — no cloud, no subscriptions, no data leaves the machine.

## Key Features

- Push-to-Talk dictation with global hotkey (Ctrl+Alt+D)
- Local Whisper V3 Turbo for speech-to-text
- Local LLM integration via Ollama (Gemma 3 4B default)
- Text injection at 1,000 WPM into any Windows application
- Ask Mode (Ctrl+Alt+A) — voice Q&A with local LLM
- Refine Mode (Ctrl+Alt+R) — AI-powered text editing
- Translate Mode (Ctrl+Alt+T) — English/Spanish bidirectional
- Quick Chat (Ctrl+Alt+C) — floating LLM overlay
- Read Selection (Ctrl+Alt+Q) — text-to-speech via local Kokoro engine
- Voice Snippets — phrase-triggered text expansion
- Audio Ducking — auto-lowers background music during recording
- Streaming Dictation — real-time transcription via cloud (optional)
- PII scrubbing and encrypted credential storage

## Pricing

- Free Trial: Complimentary cloud credits included
- Power License: $25 one-time purchase (unlimited local use)

## Technical

- Built with C# and WinUI 3
- Self-contained .exe (no runtime install required)
- Windows 10+ only (x64)
- NVIDIA GPU recommended for local STT/LLM
